title: Untwisting the normalized positive projective-line splitting
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring killed by N>0, S any scheme with N invertible, t a normalized positive transport and c:A_P->A_P(1)[2]. If the biproduct map with components the shifted twisted unit and the pushed-forward Chern adjunct of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] is invertible, then p1DecompositionMap A N hN hA S hS c of [def-sp-p1-decomposition-arrows] is invertible. No Chern specification or Noetherianity is assumed in this cancellation statement.

proof.text: Put K=A_S(-1)[-2], L=A_S(1)[2]. Their canonical evaluation is invertible because the normalized sheaf product is an isomorphism, and derived tensor cancels the even shifts. Tensor the given biproduct isomorphism with K and use preservation of binary biproducts.
Properness of q and the finite-coefficient proper projection formula give an isomorphism from the tensored direct image to Rq_*(q^-1 K tensor L_P). Follow by evaluation to identify this with Rq_*A_P.

Take adjoints of both components using [lem-amb-tensor-projection-adjunct]. The evaluation square and right-unit equation of [lem-asd-finite-twist-derived-evaluation-pullback] identify the first adjoint with the constant comparison and the second with tensoring c followed by evaluation. Thus the transported biproduct isomorphism is exactly (1,h).
